leader_definition.annual: Strategy-independent hindsight evaluation label: >=$50M median dollar-volume in first 20 sessions, price >=$5, >=80% session coverage, period return >=40%, top 20 by calendar/YTD return.
leader_definition.primary: Annual Top10 is primary; Top20 and mega-liquid are supporting views.
leader_definition.rolling: Independent 126-session superleader label: start liquidity >=$50M, forward MFE >=80%, cross-sectional forward-MFE percentile >=98%, 126-session cooldown.
leader_definition.important: Leader labels are frozen and hashed before strategy simulations; labels are evaluation-only and never enter a signal or ranking.
